FULL TEXT:
RECRUITMENT NOTICE
No. NU/NT/Job/Nov-2026 Date: 05.11.2026
Nalanda University, Rajgir is an avant-garde “International” University, designated as
institution of “National Importance” established by an Act of the Indian Parliament (Nalanda
University Act, 2010) under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, GOI.
The University invites applications from eligible candidates for the engagement of
following Non-Teaching Positions on contract on consolidated Pay basis:
1. Sports Manager (01 Post)
2. Female Gym Instructor (01 Post)
SL DETAILED ADVERTISEMENT
1
SPORTS MANAGER
No. of the Post : 01
Nature of Engagement : On Contract for a period of 01 Years Initially
(Extendable subject to satisfactory performance and requirement
of the University)
Consolidated Pay : Negotiable
Minimum Educational Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s Degree in Physical Education
 Preferred: Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.), Sports Science, Sports
Management, Physical Education & Sports, or an equivalent relevant discipline from a
recognized institution.
Experience:
 Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in university/college sports, sports administration,
facility management, coaching, sports academy operations or a comparable environment.
 Recognised coaching certification/diploma from SAI/NSNIS, National Sports Federation or
another recognised institution will be an advantage.
 Demonstrated coaching expertise in at least one recognised sport is desirable.
 Participation/coaching experience at University, State, National or International level will
be an added advantage.
 Experience in managing sports facilities, organising tournaments, handling equipment
/inventory and developing student teams will be strongly preferred.
Desired Competencies
The ideal candidate should be hands-on, energetic and student-oriented, with strong leadership,
coaching, planning and execution capabilities. The role requires regular on-field presence and
willingness to work during early mornings, evenings and weekends, depending on training and
competition schedules.
Key Responsibilities
 Sports Infrastructure & Facilities: Oversee the day-to-day functioning, utilisation and
upkeep of playgrounds, courts, gymnasium, indoor/outdoor sports facilities and equipment;
coordinate maintenance, repairs and infrastructure upgrades.
 Sports Planning & Execution: Develop and execute the University's annual sports calendar,
including regular activities, tournaments, leagues, annual sports meets, fitness initiatives and
recreational programmes.
 Coaching & Student Development: Conduct/supervise regular coaching and practice
sessions, identify sporting talent, mentor students, develop University teams and prepare
students for competitive events.
 Competitions & Events: Organise intra-University and inter-university competitions and
coordinate team selection, registrations, equipment, travel and other logistics.
 Sports Administration: Maintain records of facilities, equipment, inventory, student
participation and achievements; support procurement and budget planning; prepare periodic
reports.
 Team & Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with coaches, trainers, ground staff and
relevant University departments to ensure smooth and safe conduct of all sporting activities.
 Student Engagement & Sports Culture: Drive participation across the student community
while promoting fitness, teamwork, discipline, sportsmanship and competitive excellence.
2
FEMALE GYM INSTRUCTOR
No. of the Post : 01
Nature of Engagement : On Contract for a period of 01 Years Initially
(Extendable subject to satisfactory performance and requirement
of the University)
Consolidated Pay : Negotiable
Minimum Educational Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) / Sports Science / Exercise & Fitness / related
discipline from a recognized institution.
Experience:
 Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a Gym Instructor, Fitness Trainer, Personal
Trainer or Strength & Conditioning Trainer or Physical education & Health Teacher.
 Prior experience working in a University, educational institution, sports centre, fitness centre or
professional gym will be an advantage.
 Certification in sports and sporty injury.
Desired Skill
The ideal candidate should have sound knowledge of fitness training, strength and conditioning, gym
equipment, exercise techniques and safety protocols. She should possess strong communication and
interpersonal skills and be comfortable working closely with students.
Candidates should be energetic, disciplined, approachable and hands-on, with a strong commitment to
promoting fitness and well-being within the University community.
Key Responsibilities
 Supervise the day-to-day functioning of the women’s gymnasium, games, physical education
and ensure a safe, disciplined and welcoming fitness environment.
 Conduct regular fitness, strength, conditioning, mobility and general exercise sessions for
students.
 Guide users on the correct and safe use of gym equipment, exercise techniques and appropriate
workout routines.
 Develop basic individual and group fitness programmes based on fitness levels and goals.
 Monitor students during workouts and provide guidance on posture, form, warm-up, cool-down
and injury prevention.
 Conduct basic fitness assessments and track progress, wherever required.
 Ensure gym equipment is properly used, maintained and stored; promptly report maintenance
or safety concerns.
 Maintain required records related to gym usage, equipment and activities.
 Support the University in organising fitness challenges, wellness activities, sports camps and
related student-engagement initiatives.
 Ensure adherence to University rules, gym timings, safety standards and hygiene protocols.
The Last date for receiving applications is 27.11.2026. Applications received after
the closing date will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this
regard.
HOW TO APPLY:
1. Candidates are required to apply only through the Link given at end of the
advertisement or on the University Website. No hard copy of the application
will be accepted.
Since the link is based on a Google Form, you are requested to log in to your
Gmail account before clicking on the link. If you do not have a Gmail Account,
please create one before accessing the link.
2. APPLICATION PROCESS:
The application process has following two mandatory stages:
(A) Filling of Application Form (Google Form) and
(B) Forwarding copy of the filled Application Form with enclosures of required
supporting document to Recruitment Cell, Nalanda University.
(A) FILLING OF APPLICATION FORM (GOOGLE FORM)
(i) Click on the given Link and carefully fill t he Application Form, and then
SUBMIT.
(ii) After successful submission of the Application Form, the applicant will receive a
copy of the Filled Application Form on his/her registered Email.
(B) FORWARDING OF APPLICATION FORM TO RECRUITMENT CELL, NU
The applicant is required to FORWARD (and not compose a separate email)
the copy of that filled Application Form received at his/her registered email to
the Recruitment Cell, Nalanda University at recruitment@nalandauniv.edu.in
along with the following enclosure:
Enclosure: Enclose of a SINGLE PDF FILE Containing - Updated CV with
Passport Size Photograph; Qualification Certificates and Mark Sheets
(Graduation onward only); Experience Certificates and Other relevant
supporting documents.
3. Merely filling the Application Form shall not be considered completion of the
application process unless Application Form along with required document is
forwarded to recruitment@nalandauniv.edu.in on or before the closing date of the
Notice. Failing this, the application shall be treated as Incomplete Application.
4. Incomplete applications or applications without required supporting
documents; and application received after closing date will be liable to be
rejected, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
5. Enclosure should be a SINGLE PDF FILE only, containing- all the required
documents mentioned above. Submission of multiple files, separate emails, or files
in ZIP, RAR, or any other compressed file format will lead to rejection of the
Application Form.
6. Applicants must use the same email address for filling the Application Form and
forwarding Application Form.
7. Applicants must not submit the required documents separately or through
multiple/part-wise emails.
8. Documents must be clearly scanned using a proper scanner and submitted in a
clean, legible, and printable format. Scanned documents that are tilted, distorted,
unclear, cropped, or otherwise not suitable for printing (particularly scanned
using mobile phones) may lead to rejection of the application.
9. Applicants are advised to submit only ONE application for each post. Multiple
applications or multiple emails submitted for the same post may lead to rejection of
the application(s).
10. An application fee of Rs. 500/-(including GST) shall be paid online directly to
the University’s Bank Account (through Net Banking / UPI). The UTR
Number/Transaction Reference Number must be mentioned in the
Application Form for reference. Details of the University’s Bank Account are
given below.
Name of Account : Nalanda University
Bank Name : HDFC Bank Ltd.
Account No. : 50100079546912
IFSC Code : HDFC0002059
Swift Code : HDFCINBB
Branch Address : Dharamsala Road, Rajgir – 803 116
GENERAL INSTRUCTION:
1. The Applicants must be citizens of India.
2. Candidates currently working in a government body, autonomous body, or Public Sector
Undertaking (PSU) are required to produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) when called
for an interview or selection process.
3. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum requirements, and
the mere fulfilment of these requirements shall not entitle a candidate to be called for
an interview. Where the number of applications received is large, the University
reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for further stages of
selection based on qualifications, experience and overall suitability.
4. The candidate is responsible for the information filled in the Application Form.
5. Incomplete application Forms shall not be considered for shortlisting and the criteria
of shortlisting shall be as per the Institutional requirements and norms.
6. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the selection process. Any changes of dates
etc. also will be communicated either by publishing in the website and thus candidates
are requested to visit the website regularly.
7. The Nalanda University reserves all rights to increase or decrease the number of
position and fill/not fill the advertised post.
8. The interview shall be conducted in Offline / Online mode as applicable. Timings shall
be shared after the scrutiny of applications by email only.
9. The decision of the University related to all matters pertaining to the selection shall be
final and binding on the applicants. No candidate will have any claim for issue of
appointment letter, as a matter of right, even after recommendations by the Selection
(Interview) Committee.
10. Selected candidate must be ready to join immediately.
11. Any other rule, as applicable will be followed, although not mentioned above.
12. Intimation about the Shortlisted Candidates for Interview and the selected candidate
will be informed via email only and they are expected to join immediately. Applicants
are advised to mention their correct and active email ID in the application, as all
correspondences will be through email only. Hence, regular checking of the email by
the applicant is expected.
